name: Brand Skill Orchestrator
purpose: Route a brand project through only the necessary skills, in the correct order, using existing artifacts and approvals; prevent restarts, duplicated work and manual coordination.
triggers: multi-stage brand project needs coordinated routing
existing partial brand system needs continuation without restarting finished stages
multiple people/agents/tools collaborating on one brand project need a single source of truth for what's next
non_triggers: doing deep brand strategy, verbal, visual, identity, book, brief, content or QA work itself
a single-skill request with no multi-stage coordination need
forcing every project through every stage regardless of objective
minimum_inputs: available artifacts (list of what exists, with paths/versions if known)
quality_gates: never reruns a completed stage without cause
never substitutes orchestration for domain work
uses artifact versions/approval states, not assumptions
partial projects resume cleanly from BRAND_WORKFLOW_STATE.md alone
stop_conditions: stated objective fulfilled -> COMPLETE with COMPLETION_REPORT.md
more routing remains -> PARTIAL with NEXT_SKILL_RUN.json populated
unresolvable conflict needing a human decision -> BLOCKED, state exactly what decision is needed
never route forward past an unresolved coherence gap or missing canon a downstream skill would flag
